newsitem.title: USA: Bernard Chaus sees better operating results.
newsitem.headline: Bernard Chaus sees better operating results.

text.p: Bernard Chaus Inc said Tuesday it expects improved operating performance for the second half of fiscal 1997 compared with the comparable period in the previous year.

Josephine Chaus, chairwoman, and Andrew Grossman, chief executive officer, said the improvement is expected to come from continued shipments of its Nautica line and improved performance of its Chaus line.
They issued the forecast as the company reported lower net sales for the second quarter ended December 31, 1996, resulting in a net loss of $4.3 million, or $0.16 a share.
